title: Togglier or bombardier
what_we_know: The crew record puts Markus in the nose as togglier. His obituary makes him master bombardier, relief navigator and co-pilot, and sends the food drops over Holland and France.
what_we_dont: Whether he trained or served as a bombardier at any point.
what_might_answer_it: His service record; the 95th's records of the crew's positions.
evidence_needed: A wartime paper naming his position.
